inputs.text:
It's good to see President Trump withdrawing the United States from the Paris Agreement for the second time. This globalist deal was always a bad bargain that threatened our national sovereignty and forced American industries and families to shoulder burdens while others benefited from the foundation laid by China and the US. 

The progressive whining about it entrenching inequalities and dodging accountability for some supposed climate crisis is just the usual attempt to blame traditional American strength and corporate success for problems created by reckless international schemes. These agreements don't protect the vulnerable; they undermine our ability to lead through real responsibility and innovation at home. We need to reject this push for structural change that weakens our traditions and put America first instead of propping up failed global efforts that erode personal accountability and cultural continuity.
